status: approved by the user on 4 November 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Copyright Act 2022 (as enacted). Each query names the one section that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against this release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday and legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 4 November 2026.

queries.query: What kinds of works can be protected by copyright in Nigeria?
queries.note: s.2(1) literary, musical, artistic, audiovisual works, sound recordings and broadcasts.

queries.query: Can I copyright an idea or a business concept?
queries.note: s.3(a) ideas, procedures and concepts are not eligible.

queries.query: Do I need to register my song before it is protected by copyright?
queries.note: s.4 no formality required.

queries.query: What rights does an author of a book have under the Copyright Act?
queries.note: s.9 exclusive rights in literary and musical works.

queries.query: Can I stop someone from distorting my artwork or removing my name from it?
queries.note: s.14 author's moral rights.

queries.query: Do radio stations have to pay musicians for playing their recorded songs?
queries.note: s.15 right to remuneration for broadcasting sound recordings.

queries.query: Does an artist get a share when their painting is resold at auction?
queries.note: s.17 resale right.

queries.query: How long does copyright last after the author dies?
queries.note: s.19(1)(a) 70 years after the year of death.

queries.query: Is it fair use to quote part of a book in my review or for private study?
queries.note: s.20(1) fair dealing exceptions.

queries.query: Can a teacher photocopy pages of a textbook for students?
queries.note: s.23 reprographic copying by educational institutions (limit of five per cent).

queries.query: Can books be converted to braille for blind people without the author's permission?
queries.note: s.26 exceptions for print-disabled persons.

queries.query: If I write software for my employer, who owns the copyright?
queries.note: s.28 first ownership, works made in employment.

queries.query: Must a copyright assignment be in writing?
queries.note: s.30 assignment and licence.

queries.query: What counts as copyright infringement under Nigerian law?
queries.note: s.36 infringement of copyright.

queries.query: Who can sue for copyright infringement and what can the court award?
queries.note: s.37 action for infringement, damages, injunction, accounts.

queries.query: Can I get a court order to seize pirated copies before the trial?
queries.note: s.38 order for inspection and seizure.

queries.query: What is the punishment for selling pirated CDs or books in Nigeria?
queries.note: s.44 criminal liability for infringement.

queries.query: Can the copyright owner file a criminal case and a civil case at the same time?
queries.note: s.47 simultaneous actions.

queries.query: What anti-piracy labels or marks can the Copyright Commission require?
queries.note: s.49 anti-piracy measures.

queries.query: Is it illegal to break the digital lock on a movie or software?
queries.note: s.50 circumvention of technological protection measures.

queries.query: How do I get a website to remove my stolen content?
queries.note: s.54 notice to take down.

queries.query: What must an internet service provider do after receiving a takedown notice?
queries.note: s.55 take down of infringing content.

queries.query: Can a social media account be suspended for repeated copyright infringement?
queries.note: s.56 suspension of accounts of repeat infringers.

queries.query: Can the Copyright Commission block a piracy website?
queries.note: s.61 blocking access to online content.

queries.query: What rights do musicians and actors have over recordings of their performances?
queries.note: s.63 rights of performers.

queries.query: How long are a performer's rights protected?
queries.note: s.70 50 years from the end of the year of fixation.

queries.query: Is Nigerian folklore protected by copyright law?
queries.note: s.74 protection of expressions of folklore.

queries.query: What does the Nigerian Copyright Commission do?
queries.note: s.78 functions and powers of the Commission.

queries.query: Can copyright inspectors enter a shop without a warrant?
queries.note: s.86(2) Copyright Officers' powers without warrant.

queries.query: How do I register my work with the Nigerian Copyright Commission?
queries.note: s.87 Register of Works.

queries.query: What is a collective management organisation like COSON or MCSN?
queries.note: s.88 collective management organisations.

queries.query: Who settles disputes about royalties under the Copyright Act?
queries.note: s.90 Dispute Resolution Panel.
